title: Multi-Library Feature Engineering and Statistically Validated Classification for Power Swing Detection and Stability Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.20364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Faults occurring during power swings, and the evolution of a swing into an unstable condition, cause distance-relay maloperation and cascaded outages. This paper identifies faults, faults during power swings, and power swings, and distinguishes stable from unstable swings in a 9-bus WSCC system modeled in PSCAD/EMTDC. Three time-series feature libraries (tsfresh, TSFEL, and tsfeatures) are applied to the 3-phase relay voltages and currents, giving 3286 statistical, temporal, spectral, and fractal descriptors per event window. A two-step feature selection (Boruta all-relevant filtering followed by RFECV- and SHAP-guided minimal-optimal pruning) reduces the feature set to 18 compact, non-redundant features. 14 classifiers spanning linear, kernel/instance-based, probabilistic, neural, and tree-ensemble/boosting families are then benchmarked under repeated stratified cross-validation, with model differences assessed by a Friedman/Nemenyi o

translated_title: 多库特征工程与统计验证分类方法用于电力系统振荡检测与稳定性评估
translated_abstract: 电力系统振荡期间发生的故障，以及振荡演变为失步（不稳定）状态，会导致距离继电器误动作和连锁停电事故。本文在PSCAD/EMTDC中建模的9节点WSCC系统上，实现了对故障、振荡期间故障以及电力系统振荡的识别，并区分稳定振荡与失步振荡。该方法将三个时间序列特征库应用于三相继电器电压和电流信号，每个事件窗口可提取3286个统计、时域、频谱和分形特征描述子。通过两步特征选择（先进行Boruta全相关特征筛选，随后采用RFECV和SHAP引导的最小最优剪枝），将特征集缩减为18个紧凑且无冗余的特征。随后对涵盖线性、核/基于实例、概率模型、神经网络以及树集成/提升等家族的14种分类器进行基准测试，采用重复分层交叉验证，并通过Friedman/Nemenyi检验评估模型间的性能差异。
tldr: 该论文融合三大时间序列特征库提取3286个特征，通过两步特征选择筛选出18个紧凑无冗余特征，并以统计检验系统验证了14种分类器在振荡检测及稳定/失步判别中的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper extracts 3286 descriptors from three time-series feature libraries, employs two-step feature selection to obtain 18 compact non-redundant features, and statistically validates 14 classifiers for power swing detection and stable/unstable swing classification in a 9-bus WSCC system.
